# Foundation Requirements Quality Checklist: B0 — Foundation

**Purpose**: Founder pre-implementation review of the B0 requirements (spec, plan, contracts) for money and business-date correctness, app-shell scope, quality gates, and batch boundaries
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines it is satisfied.
**Review Record (2026-09-28)**: The builder mapped each of the 40 criteria to evidence in spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/ and docs/DECISIONS.md (D-B0-01…D-B0-11) after the `/speckit-analyze` fixes; Abdullrahman reviewed that evidence and approved marking all 40 items `[x]` on 2026-09-28.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive run): depth = formal pre-implementation gate; audience = Abdullrahman
(founder reviewer) with Codex as independent reviewer; focus = (1) money/date correctness, (2) B0 scope
and Definition of Done.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the accepted input characters, separators, and decimal-place limits for money parsing fully specified, including Arabic-Indic digits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, approved D-B0-01]
- [x] CHK002 Is the display format for negative money amounts specified for RTL text? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, approved D-B0-02]
- [x] CHK003 Is the exact set of rounding primitives required in B0 enumerated, with each tied to a Section 8.2 formula? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contracts money.md]
- [x] CHK004 Is every Cairo date helper B0 must provide listed, with no helper implied but unlisted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010, Contracts dates.md]
- [x] CHK005 Are the exact contents of the B0 home page specified (heading text source, absence of other copy)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, approved D-B0-06]
- [x] CHK006 Are all five quality checks named with a single command each and a pass condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Contracts quality-gates.md]
- [x] CHK007 Are the required lines of the B0 batch report (including `not applicable` entries) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK008 Are the Arabic user-facing parse-error messages specified in the contract exactly as approved in D-B0-01, with one message per error code? [Completeness, Contracts money.md, Rule 13, approved D-B0-01]
- [x] CHK009 Is the content of the `CHANGELOG.md` B0 entry and the B0 `docs/DECISIONS.md` update defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is the PostgreSQL signed-`bigint` piaster range defined with exact min/max, and are parser, formatter and JSON-wire bounds testable at both edges? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, approved D-B0-03]
- [x] CHK011 Is "round half up" defined unambiguously for exact ties (e.g. 2.5 → 3) and restricted to non-negative inputs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, approved D-B0-04]
- [x] CHK012 Is "ceil to step" defined precisely as the smallest multiple of the step at or above the exact ratio? [Clarity, Contracts money.md]
- [x] CHK013 Is the Cairo day range defined as half-open, with its end instant stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data-model]
- [x] CHK014 Is the space character in `20,000.00 ج.م` specified (plain space vs non-breaking)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, approved D-B0-02]
- [x] CHK015 Is "no hardcoded product name elsewhere" scoped to specific directories/file types so the guard is objective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK016 Is "usable at 360 px without horizontal scrolling" expressed as a measurable condition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK017 Are the money exact-value examples in User Story 1, SC-002, and contracts/money.md identical? [Consistency, Spec §US1, SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Is the parser's rejection of signs consistent with the `bigint` value type allowing negative balances (Section 6.10) and wire strings permitting signed internal values? [Consistency, Data-model, approved D-B0-01/03]
- [x] CHK019 Is the statement that no installment schedule is computed in TypeScript consistent with Section 9.2 (`preview_installment_schedule`) and with B0's rounding-helper scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK020 Are the deferred Section 3.1 paths (lib/supabase, types/database.ts, seed.sql, routes) consistently excluded across spec, plan, and research? [Consistency, Plan §Structure, Research R14]
- [x] CHK021 Do the constitution-check statuses in the plan agree with the spec's out-of-scope list (no ledger, tenants, postings)? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK022 Is the stricter 100% coverage target for `dates.ts` presented as a plan choice and not as a new master-spec rule? [Consistency, Research R8]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK023 Can the 100% coverage criterion be objectively measured per file and per metric (lines, branches, functions, statements)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, SC-001]
- [x] CHK024 Are the date boundary expectations stated as exact instants and exact dates for both UTC+2 and UTC+3 periods? [Measurability, Spec §US2, Contracts dates.md]
- [x] CHK025 Is "CI green" defined as a specific set of named jobs passing on a specific branch? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK026 Is SC-004 (clean-machine setup without undocumented steps) verifiable, with the prerequisite list stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Quickstart]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are money edge cases (empty, `.5`, `5.`, leading zeros, bad grouping, exponent, NaN/Infinity, mixed digit systems) each assigned an expected outcome? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, approved D-B0-01]
- [x] CHK028 Are DST transition days specified with their expected day lengths (23 h / 25 h)? [Coverage, Spec §US2-5, Research R7]
- [x] CHK029 Is leap-day behavior specified for both conversion and validation? [Coverage, Contracts dates.md]
- [x] CHK030 Is the requirement that results are identical under non-Cairo machine time zones specified with the zones to test? [Coverage, Spec §US2-6, SC-003]
- [x] CHK031 Are failure modes of `bigint` rounding (zero/negative denominator or step, result outside signed-64-bit piasters) specified as programming errors and distinguished from user-facing validation? [Coverage, Contracts money.md, approved D-B0-04]

## Non-Functional, Security & Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK032 Are secret-handling requirements for B0 stated (nothing committed, no privileged key in the browser) and is it explicit that no env example is needed yet? [Security, Spec §FR-023, Research R14]
- [x] CHK033 Is it explicit that B0 creates zero migrations, tables, and functions, and is that stated as a checkable outcome? [Scope, Spec §FR-026, SC-008]
- [x] CHK034 Is it explicit that Section 14 T01–T30 and seeded reconciliation are reported `not applicable` in B0, never `passed`? [Scope, Spec §FR-027, Workflow B0 DoD]
- [x] CHK035 Is the requirement that `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` contain Section 18 verbatim paired with a drift check, and is the Spec Kit agent-context conflict addressed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, Research R13]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Are machine prerequisites (container runtime, disk space, Node version, network access) documented as assumptions with their impact on local evidence? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Research table]
- [x] CHK037 Is the dependency on push authorization for CI evidence documented and linked to a decision? [Dependency, approved D-B0-07]
- [x] CHK038 Is the risk of pinning Next.js 14 (two majors behind current) documented without silently amending Section 3? [Assumption, Research R1]
- [x] CHK039 Is the timing of `docs/ACCOUNTING.md` recorded so its absence in B0 is not an unnoticed gap? [Gap, approved D-B0-08]
- [x] CHK040 Is the approved CI-only B0 fallback for pgTAP and Playwright explicit, with attempted local commands reported `blocked` rather than `passed`, 5/5 green CI required and local DB fixed before B1? [Dependency, approved D-B0-09] *(appended after `/speckit-analyze`)*

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Entries tagged `approved D-B0-xx` are confirmed in `docs/DECISIONS.md`; their checklist criteria still need independent founder review before being checked.
- 40 items; 100% carry a traceability reference
